name: MeepleStats---Backend
description: A self-hosted web application designed to track board game statistics for your group of friends! It allows users to log game sessions, analyze player performance, and manage a wishlist of games. This is the backend component.

variables.name: BoardGameGeek Username
variables.description: Your BoardGameGeek username for fetching game data

variables.name: Database - URL
variables.description: MongoDB connection string

variables.name: Database - Name
variables.description: Name of the MongoDB database to use

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Use `openssl rand -base64 32`

variables.name: CORS Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins (e.g. http://localhost:3000)

variables.name: JWT - Secret Key
variables.description: Use `openssl rand -base64 32`

variables.name: JWT - Expiration (seconds)
variables.description: Expiration time for JWT access tokens in seconds

variables.name: JWT - Storage
variables.description: Storage method for JWT tokens

variables.name: JWT - Token Location
variables.description: Token location, e.g. headers, cookies

variables.name: JWT - Secure Cookies
variables.description: Whether to use secure cookies for JWT

variables.name: JWT - Access Cookie Name
variables.description: Name of the JWT access cookie

variables.name: JWT - CRSF Protection
variables.description: Whether to enable CSRF protection for JWT cookies

variables.name: JWT - Storage
variables.description: Storage method for JWT tokens

variables.name: Storage - Type
variables.description: Type of storage to use for file uploads

variables.name: Storage - S3 Endpoint
variables.description: S3 endpoint URL (required if using S3 storage)

variables.name: Storage - S3 Access Key
variables.description: S3 access key (required if using S3 storage)

variables.name: Storage - S3 Secret Key
variables.description: S3 secret key (required if using S3 storage)

variables.name: Storage - S3 Bucket Name
variables.description: S3 bucket name (required if using S3 storage)

variables.name: Rulesbooks Chat (RAG) - Enable
variables.description: Enable Rulesbooks Chat (RAG) integration

variables.name: Rulesbooks Chat (RAG) - Pinecone API Key
variables.description: Pinecone API key for RAG integration

variables.name: Rulesbooks Chat (RAG) - Pinecone Index Name
variables.description: Pinecone index name for RAG integration

variables.name: Rulesbooks Chat (RAG) - Embedding Type
variables.description: Embedding type for RAG integration

variables.name: Rulesbooks Chat (RAG) - Embedding Model
variables.description: Embedding model for RAG integration. Example: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5

variables.name: Rulesbooks Chat (RAG) - Gemini API Key
variables.description: Gemini API key for RAG integration

variables.name: Rulesbooks Chat (RAG) - Pinecone Dimension
variables.description: Chunk size for RAG document processing

variables.name: Rulesbooks Chat (RAG) - OpenRouter API Key
variables.description: OpenRouter API key for RAG integration

variables.name: Rulesbooks Chat (RAG) - LLM Model
variables.description: LLM model for RAG integration. Example: qwen/qwq-32b:free

variables.name: Internal Upload Folder
variables.description: Path inside the container for uploaded files
